title: 弥生賞の後に・時は金なり

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon finishes the Yayoi Sho while also collecting her desired data.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She mutters about how she'll need it to make proper preparations for the upcoming Satsuki Sho before returning to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Something seems to be weighing heavily on her mind, yet she shows no intention of revealing it to me.
